amphenol.name: High Precision GNSS Multi-Band Active Patch Antenna (L1/L2/L5)
amphenol.description: Industrial grade high-precision GNSS active antenna supporting GPS, GLONASS, Galileo, and BeiDou frequencies (L1/L2/L5/E1/E5b) for RTK and centimeter-level positioning accuracy.
features: Multi-band support: GPS L1/L2/L5, GLONASS G1/G2, Galileo E1/E5b, BeiDou B1/B2/B3
High gain LNA (28dB - 38dB) with low noise figure (<1.5dB)
IP67 / IP69K weatherproof enclosure with UV resistant casing
Low power consumption for IoT and autonomous vehicle applications
Pre-filtered high out-of-band rejection for cellular & Wi-Fi immunity

amphenol.name: Embedded Flexible FPC Dual-Band GNSS Antenna (L1/L5)
amphenol.description: Ultra-thin flexible printed circuit (FPC) internal antenna optimized for compact IoT devices, wearables, and asset trackers requiring precise GPS/GNSS location tracking.
features: Dual-band L1 + L5 GNSS capability
Flexible 3M adhesive backing for quick installation inside plastic housings
Micro-coaxial cable assembly with IPEX MHF4 / U.FL connector
Omnidirectional radiation pattern

amphenol.name: Rugged Vehicle Dome GNSS + 5G + Wi-Fi 6E Combo Antenna
amphenol.description: Heavy-duty 5-in-1 multi-purpose vehicle antenna featuring high-precision GNSS positioning, 2x2 MIMO 5G/4G LTE, and 2x2 MIMO Wi-Fi 6E for fleet telematics and emergency vehicles.
features: 5-in-1 integrated dome design: 1x GNSS, 2x 5G/4G, 2x Wi-Fi 6E
High impact IK10 & IP69K waterproof rating
Heavy-duty bolt mount through vehicle roof
Low-loss RG58/LMR195 cable leads

amphenol.name: MIL-DTL-38999 Series III Circular Connectors
amphenol.description: High-density harsh environment circular connectors engineered for military aerospace and heavy industrial defense systems. Features triple-start thread coupling with anti-decoupling ratchet mechanism.
features: Tri-start thread coupling mechanism
100% scoop-proof contact design
EMI shielding grounding fingers
Operates up to 200°C severe thermal environments

specs.Plating: Olive Drab Cadmium / Electroless Nickel / Black Zinc Nickel

amphenol.name: Industrial M12 A-Code / D-Code / X-Code Sensor Connectors
amphenol.description: Compact IP67 sealed M12 circular connectors for industrial automation, fieldbus systems, Single Pair Ethernet (SPE), and 10GbE High-Speed Industrial Ethernet.
features: Available in A, B, D, K, L, S, T, and X coding
Shielded metal housing for high EMI noise suppression
Screw-lock and push-pull mating mechanisms

amphenol.name: D-Subminiature Standard & High Density Connectors
amphenol.description: Industry standard D-Sub connectors available in 9, 15, 25, 37, and 50 pin counts with solder cup, PCB straight, right angle, and crimp terminations.
features: Stamped and formed or machined precision pin contacts
Steel shell with tin plating for grounding continuity
UL94V-0 high temperature thermoplastic insulator

amphenol.name: Heavy Duty RADSOK Power Connectors (Up to 1000A)
amphenol.description: Patented RADSOK socket technology featuring twisted hyperbolic grid geometry for maximum contact surface area, extremely low millivolt drop, and high current carrying capability.
features: Low insertion force with high contact surface area
Handles continuous currents from 35A up to 1000A
Up to 40% more current capacity than standard pin/socket contacts

amphenol.name: Precision RF Coaxial Connectors (SMA / BNC / N-Type / TNC)
amphenol.description: High performance 50 Ohm precision RF coaxial connectors engineered for microwave, telecommunications test equipment, and high-frequency wireless communications.
features: DC to 18 GHz frequency bandwidth (SMA / N-Type)
Gold-plated center conductor contacts for minimal reflection
Threaded coupling for vibration-proof reliability

amphenol.name: Fiber Optic Connectors & Optical Patch Cords (LC / SC / MPO)
amphenol.description: Single-mode OS2 and multi-mode OM3/OM4 optical fiber patch cables equipped with low loss ceramic ferrule LC, SC, and MPO/MTP connectors.
features: Ultra low insertion loss (< 0.15 dB)
100% factory tested and end-face geometry inspected
LSZH flame-retardant outer jacket

amphenol.name: EV High-Voltage Interconnect System (HVSL 800 / Excel|Mate)
amphenol.description: High voltage 1000V DC electric vehicle power connector designed for EV battery packs, inverters, power distribution units (PDU), and motor controllers.
features: Integrated HVIL (High Voltage Interlock Loop) safety feature
360° EMI shielding against electromagnetic interference
Push-lock double-stage latching for vibration protection
IP67 / IP6K9K touch-proof IP2X protection
